top_stories.title: IDScan sued over alleged data breach affecting 153 million drivers
top_stories.summary: IDScan, an identity verification company, faces multiple lawsuits after hackers allegedly breached its systems and offered to sell data from over 153 million driver's licenses. The breach targets a company whose core business is scanning and verifying identity documents, raising significant concerns about identity verification infrastructure security.

top_stories.title: 39 New Methods That Compromise Passkey Authentication
top_stories.summary: Researchers have documented 39 methods for compromising passkey-based authentication systems. The attack vectors target authentication prompts, synced credentials, enrollment processes, recovery mechanisms, and other trust boundaries, without needing to break the underlying FIDO2 cryptography.

top_stories.title: Attackers Pounce on Critical Artifactory Bug Following Disclosure
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) has been disclosed in JFrog Artifactory, allowing attackers to gain admin-level access on affected systems. Threat actors are actively exploiting the flaw following its public disclosure.

top_stories.title: Critical Citrix NetScaler auth bypass now leveraged in attacks
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler (CVE-2026-19490) is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw allows attackers to bypass authentication controls, with exploitation confirmed by vulnerability intelligence firm Previdian.

top_stories.title: A five-part inventory for your AI agent credentials
top_stories.summary: Roy Katmor, CEO of Orchid, outlines a five-part inventory framework for managing AI agent credentials that fall outside standard identity review processes. The video addresses how AI agents receive accounts and credentials when connecting to enterprise tools like HR systems, identity providers, ticketing, and payroll, but these identities are not subject to typical access governance review.

news.title: Zero trust AI agents demand a different kind of security
news.summary: Teleport VP Chris Webber argues in an interview that zero trust principles must evolve to address AI agents, which operate faster and more unpredictably than traditional workloads. He outlines Teleport's approach using trusted runtimes with zero starting privileges and real-time identity security to monitor agent behavior continuously rather than relying on point-in-time verification.

news.title: Attackers Breached JetBrains Cadence via Unpatched TeamCity, Extracting AWS Credentials
news.summary: JetBrains suffered a security breach via an unpatched critical vulnerability in its TeamCity product, allowing attackers to access its Cadence environment and extract AWS credentials. JetBrains is urging all affected Cadence users to immediately revoke and rotate credentials and secrets used in their Cadence executions.

news.title: zitadel v4.17.3
news.summary: ZITADEL released version 4.17.3 of its open-source identity and access management platform. The platform supports SSO, MFA, passkeys, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and multi-tenant access control.

news.title: Pathlock Recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner® Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration
news.summary: Pathlock has been named a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration. The recognition places Pathlock among notable IGA vendors in Gartner's annual guide covering the evolving identity governance market.

news.title: Thomson Reuters Court Software Breach May Have Exposed SSNs and Sealed Data
news.summary: Thomson Reuters disclosed a breach of its C-Track court case management platform, affecting courts in 11 U.S. states, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Ontario, Canada. The unauthorized access occurred in March 2026 and was discovered on June 30, 2026, with potentially exposed data including SSNs and sealed court records.

news.title: Shai-Hulud's Reach Just Grew to 469 Credential Locations. Here's What That Means
news.summary: GitGuardian researchers discovered a new variant of the Shai-Hulud infostealer worm that scans for credentials across 469 locations, up from 189 in earlier variants. The expanded targets include developer environments, CI/CD tooling, cloud configurations, and AI tool configurations.

news.title: Researcher Releases FalconFlank PoC Showing Privilege Escalation in CrowdStrike Falcon
news.summary: A security researcher released a proof-of-concept exploit called FalconFlank demonstrating a privilege escalation zero-day vulnerability in CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor. The flaw abuses the office malicious macros remediation feature within the Falcon Sensor to achieve privilege escalation.

news.title: Microsoft Security enhancements: Defender MDR Plan 2, Entra Tenant Governance, Intune Autopilot, Purview Auto-Labeling, and AI Agent Containment
news.summary: Microsoft is releasing several security enhancements including Entra Tenant Governance for multi-tenant identity governance management. Additional updates include Defender MDR Plan 2 with third-party log support, Intune Autopilot improvements, Purview auto-labeling throughput increases, and AI agent containment guidance.

news.title: An infostealer log can bypass MFA—respond within the first hour
news.summary: Infostealer logs can contain active browser sessions and identity provider tokens that allow attackers to bypass MFA protections. Security teams are advised to treat corporate credentials found in infostealer logs as live identity compromises requiring immediate response within the first hour.

news.title: Your Employee’s Password Appeared in an Infostealer Log. Now What?
news.summary: Flare published guidance on responding to employee credentials exposed in infostealer logs, focusing on the risk of stolen authenticated sessions that can bypass MFA. The article covers how defenders can prioritize compromised identities and assess whether stolen access remains active and exploitable.

news.title: The $100M Signal: Why AI Agent Security is Becoming Its Own Category
news.summary: The article discusses the emergence of AI agent security as a distinct security category, driven by the shift from simple chatbots to autonomous AI agents that can execute tasks and access data on behalf of users. The piece frames traditional identity management approaches as insufficient for governing AI agents that act autonomously, raising questions about authorization, access control, and identity for non-human entities.

news.title: Keeper Security Names Jessica Krowel and Bill Grabner to Lead North America Private and Public Sector Sales
news.summary: Keeper Security appointed Jessica Krowel and Bill Grabner to lead North America private and public sector sales, respectively. The hires are described as strengthening the company's go-to-market team following recognition as the second fastest-growing security software company globally.

news.title: Back to the Future: Why Agentic AI Needs a Strong Identity Foundation
news.summary: The article examines identity foundation requirements for agentic AI deployments in enterprise environments. It addresses how AI agents require robust identity, authentication, and authorization frameworks to operate securely across automated workflows.

news.title: Old, Unpatched Flaws Give Attackers Access to Philippines Nuclear Agency
news.summary: Threat actors exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in ownCloud to breach the Philippines Nuclear Agency, stealing credential stores, personnel records, and reactor databases. The attack leveraged commodity vulnerabilities to gain initial access, resulting in the compromise of authentication credentials and sensitive identity-related data.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses, allegedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official investigation into the breach.

news.title: Anthropic Users Hit by Infostealer Attacks, Session Thefts
news.summary: A threat actor deployed infostealer malware to steal session tokens and gain unauthorized access to Anthropic Claude user accounts. The attack involved session hijacking techniques to bypass authentication controls on an unknown number of accounts.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved stolen credentials used to access Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in breaches affecting over 100 million AT&T customers' call and text records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally published dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, to a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and secrets exposure risks, with the breach going undetected until KrebsOnSecurity notified the agency.
